evidence.note: Request URI has a trailing slash; registered URI does not. Entra does exact string matching.
Only the no-trailing-slash form is registered.

evidence.actual: AADSTS50011: The redirect URI 'https://app.example.com/callback/' specified in the request does not match the redirect URIs configured for the application

output.fix: Make the redirect_uri sent in the authorization request exactly match a registered one. Either change the app to send https://app.example.com/callback (no trailing slash), or add https://app.example.com/callback/ as an additional redirect URI on the app registration. Matching is exact, so keep the same value in the authorization and token requests. Don't use wildcards or loosen the matching.

alternatives.why_not: The error is specifically AADSTS50011 and a redirect URI comparison shows a concrete difference. The client config is otherwise fine.
